summary.implementedScope: Implemented the Context Workbench foundation layer by adding shared Thread View/domain record types, workbench-specific error helpers, reusable fixture builders, temp-store helpers, and the Story 0 foundation test coverage. Existing verification script wiring already discovered the new workbench tests, so no script changes were required.
summary.acceptanceRationale: Story-lead is pausing for caller ruling 00-foundation-story-run-001-ruling-037 before impl-lead can accept the story.

evidence: `package.json:15-19` wires `green-verify` to `npm run verify && npm run guard:no-test-changes`, and the fixed guard detects staged test changes. In the current story state, `git diff --cached --name-only -- 'tests/*.test.ts' 'tests/**/*.test.ts'` reports `tests/context-workbench/foundation.test.ts`; `npm run green-verify` runs all 116 unit tests successfully, then fails in `guard:no-test-changes` with `Staged test file changes detected: tests/context-workbench/foundation.test.ts`. This conflicts with the orchestrator follow-up requirement to both detect staged relevant test-file changes and have `npm run green-verify` pass when required Story 0 files are staged.

rulingRequest.question: For Story 0, should `green-verify` be required to pass while newly added Story 0 test files remain staged, or should the no-test-change guard be evaluated only after accepted story test changes are committed/baselined?
rulingRequest.defaultRecommendation: Treat `guard:no-test-changes` as a post-baseline guard: preserve staged/unstaged/untracked detection, do not weaken it to allow staged test edits, and run `green-verify` after Story 0 test additions are committed or otherwise incorporated into the accepted baseline.
evidence: `010-verify.json` reports S0-F001 resolved: guard now detects unstaged, staged, and untracked relevant test changes.
`010-verify.json` reports `npm run verify-all` passed: unit tests 116/116, integration tests 4/4, e2e tests 24/24.
`010-verify.json` reports `npm run green-verify` fails because `guard:no-test-changes` detects staged `tests/context-workbench/foundation.test.ts`.
Prior impl-lead ruling said staging the Story 0 foundation test and implementation files made the earlier guard failure expected and required no gate policy change.
allowedResponses: Require green-verify only after Story 0 tests are committed/baselined
Change guard to allow approved staged Story 0 test additions
Block Story 0 until a different gate policy is defined
